fields.description: Leave EMPTY for a walk-in paying at the desk — then Customer Name is the receipt identity.
fields.label: Customer

fields.description: Fetched from the account when one is set; free text for a walk-in.
fields.label: Customer Name

fields.description: Walk-ins only — contact number for court issues. Staff-visible.
fields.label: Customer Phone

fields.description: Changed only through the Confirm / Cancel / Extend / Check in / Undo no-show actions and the per-minute sweep (which both expires unpaid holds and releases un-checked-in no-shows) — never edited directly.
fields.label: Booking Status
fields.options:
Reserved
Confirmed
Extended
Completed
Cancelled
Expired
No Show

fields.description: Must be the start of a slot on the branch's grid for that day.
fields.label: Start Time

fields.description: Consecutive slots booked in one go.
fields.label: Number of Slots

fields.description: Billable court time — turnover buffers between slots are not billed.
fields.label: Duration (Hours)

fields.description: Cash and Free confirm instantly; Fund Transfer holds the slot until proof is verified (or the hold expires).
fields.label: Payment Method

fields.description: WHERE the money landed — one of the company's enabled channels of the payment method's kind (Cash → a Cash channel; Fund Transfer → GCash or a bank). Left empty, the company's first enabled channel of that kind is used. Staff may correct it when verifying the proof.
fields.label: Payment Channel

fields.description: Leave as the court's base rate to let the court's rate rules price each slot; type a different rate to override them for this booking. On a booking priced by rate rules this shows the BLENDED average of its segments — display only.
fields.label: Hourly Rate

fields.description: What the customer pays: the court (after discount) plus the platform booking fee, if any.
fields.label: Total Amount

fields.description: The platform's per-booking fee the customer pays on top of the court, fixed when the booking was made from the company's tiers and printed as its own line (outside the tenant's VAT). 0 unless the company is billed Per Booking; always 0 for a Free booking.
fields.label: Booking Fee (Platform)

fields.description: The company's count of fee-carrying bookings for this service month at the moment of sale, +1 — the number the tier was read at. Not unique: an expired hold that is later retro-confirmed shares its number with the sale that took its place. 0 = carries no fee unit.
fields.label: Fee Unit #

fields.description: The first hour of the continuous session this booking continues — the booking that carries the session's one fee. Empty for a head or a lone booking.
fields.label: Fee Chained To

fields.description: The booking fee this continuation would have carried on its own, printed as 'Continuous booking discount'. 0 for a head or a lone booking.
fields.label: Booking Fee Waived (Continuation)

fields.description: Base clock: an unpaid Fund Transfer hold expires at this time unless a payment proof is uploaded first.
fields.label: Reservation Expires At

fields.description: How much of this booking's price was settled with store credit. It is a PAYMENT, not a discount — the total and the VAT footer are untouched.
fields.label: Credit Applied

fields.description: The store credit this booking drew on.
fields.label: Credit Document

fields.description: When the credit went back to the customer because this booking died. A NO SHOW is never restored — that money is forfeit.
fields.label: Credit Restored At

fields.description: Verification clock deadline — set by the payment-proof engine.
fields.label: Verification Deadline At

fields.description: This booking's own pricing snapshot, taken from the court's rate rules when it was created. Empty means a single flat rate applies. Editing the Hourly Rate above clears it and re-prices the booking flat.
fields.label: Rate Segments

fields.description: When someone actually turned up. Set by the Check in action, and automatically for an extension or a slot the desk back-records after it started. Empty is what makes a booking eligible for no-show release.
fields.label: Checked In At

fields.description: The booking this one extends (set by the Extend action).
fields.label: Extended From

fields.description: The booking this one replaces (set by the Reschedule action).
fields.label: Rescheduled From

fields.description: Where this booking was moved to (set on the ORIGINAL when it is rescheduled).
fields.label: Rescheduled To

fields.description: The cart this booking was reserved in. Every row of one checkout shares it, and they share one pay-by clock, one payment proof and one verification. Empty for a booking made on its own.
fields.label: Booking Group

fields.description: The billing statement issued for this booking (created automatically).
fields.label: Billing Document
